_README: SEO control panel. One file, every switch. Nothing here is parsed out of club names —
if a city needs a different label or URL, you declare it here.
2. Run `npm run build:seo` — regenerates robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
3. Commit both generated files along with your change.
indexed        false = the page is blocked in robots.txt AND left out of the sitemap.
publish        (clubs) false = no page, no sitemap entry. Default for thin clubs.
title/desc     null = fall back to the template in `defaults`. A string overrides it.
priority       sitemap hint, 0.0-1.0. Relative, not absolute. Homepage is 1.0.
MASTER SWITCH: `clubPages.enabled` is false until per-city pages actually exist.
Flip it to true only once the pages are live, or the sitemap will advertise 404s.

defaults.descriptionTemplate: Breakfast Club in {name}. {schedule} at {venue}. Everyone's invited. Especially you.
defaults.fallbackDescription: A global directory of Breakfast Club meetups — find your nearest one, see when it meets, and just show up.

clubPages.note: Per-city landing pages are not built yet. See docs/STATUS.md -> Discoverability.

pages.title: Breakfast Club — Find Your Nearest One

pages.title: Breakfast Club Calendar — Every Club, Every Morning
pages.description: Every Breakfast Club meetup as a month-by-month calendar. See what's on this week, anywhere in the world.

pages.title: Breakfast Club Map — Find a Club Near You
pages.description: An interactive world map of every Breakfast Club. Filter by region, tap a city, and plan a morning around it.

pages.title: Frequent Fly-Ers — Breakfast Club Flyer Wall
pages.description: Every Breakfast Club flyer, newest first. Grab one, share it, bring someone.

pages.title: Latest Happenings — What Breakfast Club Talked About
pages.description: What tables actually talked about this week, city by city.
